messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel

message.content:
I’m not aware of any dedicated “pet‑friendly” train stations in Miami, but most major stations that serve Amtrak and other rail services allow pets under certain conditions. Here’s what you can expect:

| Train Station | Main Rail Service | Pet Policy |
|---------------|-------------------|------------|
| **Miami Central Station** (formerly Miami Intermodal Center) | Amtrak (Silver Meteor, Silver Star, Palmetto) | Amtrak allows small pets in carriers that fit under the seat or in the luggage area. Pets must be leashed or in a carrier. |
| **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** | Florida East Coast Railway (Freight only) | Not applicable – freight rail does not carry passengers. |
| **Miami Beach Station** | None (no passenger rail service) | N/A |

If you’re traveling with a pet, it’s best to check directly with Amtrak or the specific rail operator for the most up‑to‑date pet policies and any required documentation.
